versions.content: If the function DoIP_SoAdTpStartOfReception is called with TpSduLength set to 0, the Do IP module shall fill in the bufferSizePtr the available buffer size in the DoIP for the reception of the TCP message, lock the according buffer for other TCP connections and return BUFREQ_OK.

If the function DoIP_SoAdTpStartOfReception is called with Tp SduLength set to 0, the DoIP module shall fill in the bufferSizePtr the available buffer size in the DoIP for the reception of the TCP message, lock the according buffer for other TCP connections and return BUFREQ_OK.
